changes.text: Moderator actions are easier to identify in deletion and audit logs.
Deleted-message entries now attribute actions more reliably.

title: Guild data stays with the bot

changes.text: Server settings and saved round details now persist in hosted PostgreSQL storage.
The deployment no longer depends on a local persistent disk.
Saved lobby codes and the dead-player list are restored when dea comes back online.
The bot presence now shows its current uptime.
A public status dashboard shows the bot connection, server count, gateway ping and process uptime.
The health page refreshes automatically while it is open.
Server logs include clearer event details and command activity.
Deleted-message logs can show image attachments directly in the entry.
Actor attribution is more reliable for Discord audit events.
